purpose: Independent practice of D1.1 — sorting by 2 attributes with Venn and Carroll diagrams.
student_learning_goal: I can sort by two attributes using Venn or Carroll.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can sort by two attributes using Venn or Carroll.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dot in the top-right corner with a magnifying glass over a 2-attribute table. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Place 6 items in the Venn (red circle / square circle / both / neither).
parts.visual_layout: A 2-circle Venn diagram with 4 zones labeled. Below: 6 items to place.

image_placeholders.description: A 2-circle Venn diagram for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Left circle labelled 'RED', right circle labelled 'SQUARE'. Wide overlap zone in the middle. Outside the circles, a 'NEITHER' label. Below the diagram, 6 items to place: red triangle, blue square, red square, blue triangle, red circle, blue circle.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P1_VENN at Part 1: instructions ask the child to place 6 items in a Venn. Keywords name the visual element and the 2 attributes.

parts.answer_key: Red triangle: red only. Blue square: square only. Red square: overlap. Blue triangle: outside. Red circle: red only. Blue circle: outside.

parts.student_instructions: Place the same 6 items in a Carroll (red x square).

image_placeholders.description: A 2x2 Carroll diagram for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Headers: top columns 'SQUARE' / 'NOT SQUARE'; left rows 'RED' / 'NOT RED'. 4 cells, each ~2in × 2in for placing items.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P2_CARROLL at Part 2: instructions ask the child to place items in Carroll. Keywords name the visual element and 2 attributes.

parts.answer_key: Red+Square cell: red square. Red+NotSquare: red triangle, red circle. NotRed+Square: blue square. NotRed+NotSquare: blue triangle, blue circle.

parts.student_instructions: Pick 2 attributes for 4 of your toys. Make a Venn OR Carroll.

image_placeholders.description: A blank workspace ~5in × 4in for a Grade 2 worksheet. Above: 'Attribute 1: ___' and 'Attribute 2: ___'. Below: blank area for child to draw Venn or Carroll.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P3_BLANK at Part 3: instructions ask the child to make their own. Keywords name the activity.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, try a 3-attribute Venn (3 circles).
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Use Part 1 for diagnostic — children placing in correct overlap zone.
